verdict.rationale: Poly is cloud storage with a desktop sync folder, not a true local-first store. Files appear as a real Finder/Explorer folder, pinned content stays downloaded and is never evicted, journal notes are plain Markdown files, and offline edits queue and sync later. However, files download on demand by default, and nothing shows that search, the agent or Mind work offline. missing for 10: local-first ownership (storage is cloud-primary), evidence that all features work fully offline, evidence that files stay readable if the app or account goes away, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, my notes live in local files or a local-first store that I own and can read without the app, and everything keeps working fully offline

citations.quote: your Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, with files downloading on demand and syncing back automatically.
Keep Downloaded (pinned) — the content is downloaded eagerly and never evicted.
The queue survives restarts, so work done on a plane syncs itself when you land
New journal entries are Markdown files synced to your **Mind** folder.
